evidence: The films were grown on silicon and borosilicate glass substrates. The 70 nm thick film grown at 300 -C using Hf : Ca pulse ratio 1 : 1 possessed effective permittivity 14 T 0.2, measured at 500 kHz, while the 164 nm thick film grown using Hf : Ca pulse ratio 3 : 1 possessed permittivity value 13.2 T 0.4. The 134 nm thick CaO film was additionally covered with 7 – 10 nm thick Al 2O3 protection layer atomic layer deposited at 300 -C from Al(CH 3)3 and H 2O. The films were grown at 300 -C, except the films with cycling sequence 300 /C2[1 /C2HfO2 +1 /C2CaO], grown at 230 -C. The CaO films were grown using 1.0 and 0.6 s Ca(Cp 3i)2 pulse lengths, respectively. The 134 nm thick CaO film was additionally covered with 7 – 10 nm thick Al 2O3 protection layer atomic layer deposited at 300 -C from Al(CH3)3 and H 2O. The film thicknesses were measured from optical spectra.
